final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) as avg_amt FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(amount) as global_avg FROM budget), step3 AS (SELECT s1.link_to_event, s1.avg_amt, s1.avg_amt - s2.global_avg as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_amt > s2.global_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3) SELECT s3.link_to_event, s3.avg_amt, s3.diff, s3.avg_amt - s4.avg_diff as final_diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 ORDER BY final_diff DESC LIMIT 10
